faqs.q: Sec. 42-99. - I.F.C. Section D103.6.1, Roads 20-26 feet in width.
faqs.a:
Section D103.6.1. Roads 20-26 feet in width
, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
D103.6.1. Roads less than 30 feet in width.
Fire lane signs as specified in Section D103.6 shall be posted on both sides of private
                  streets, roads, or drives designated as fire apparatus access that are less than 30
                  feet wide (9,144 mm). Installation method of fire lane signs shall be in accordance
                  with City of Arvada Engineering Standards."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
